en: Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic/Romanesque hilltop complex comprising a cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle-like palace and round tower, rising above a riverside town. In the foreground, steam-powered riverboats with tall funnels travel along a broad river, producing dark smoke. Traditional European houses and a small turreted riverside building sit between the water and the steep, wooded hill leading up to the castle and cathedral.
